questions.stem: A solution has a concentration of 2 mol/dm³. If 100 cm³ is diluted to 500 cm³, what is the new concentration?
questions.explanation: The number of moles stays the same during dilution: n = 2 × 0.1 = 0.2 mol. The new volume is 500 cm³ = 0.5 dm³. New concentration = n/V = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 mol/dm³.
